name: Google Sheets
description: Create, read, and modify Google Sheets via a Google service account. Useful for capturing scraped data, agent output, or reports as a shareable spreadsheet.

fields.label: Your Google email (sheets will be shared with you as writer)

Drive folder ID (REQUIRED on personal Google accounts — service accounts have no Drive of their own. Create a folder, share it with the service account email as Editor, paste the folder ID from the URL after /folders/. Leave blank on Workspace accounts with Shared Drives.)

quick_commands.description: Create a new Google Sheet with the given title
